parole.significato: A title borne by rulers of the Kushano-Sasanian Kingdom.
parole.testo: From Middle Persian [Term?] (literally “king of the Kushans”) (modern Persian: کوشانشاه (kūšānšāh /kušânšâh)). By surface analysis, Kushan + shah.

parole.significato: the title of the military commander or commander-in-chief in Sassanian-era Persia
parole.testo: From Middle Persian 𐭮𐭯𐭠𐭧𐭯𐭲𐭩 (spʾḥpty /⁠spāhbed⁠/). Doublet of sparapet.

parole.significato: Any of a collection of hymns and prayers.
parole.testo: From Middle Persian yšt' (yašt, “prayer, worship”), probably from Avestan 𐬫𐬀𐬱𐬙𐬀 (yašta, “honored”), from 𐬫𐬀𐬰 (yaz, “to worship, honor”), from Proto-Indo-European *h₁yaǵ-.

parole.significato: An Islamic book that tabulates parameters used for various astronomical events and movements.
